title: 相量图法：端口电压与电流同相
statement: 图示电路中 R、C 并联后与 L 串联，参数未知。已知电源电压有效值 U = 100 V，R 与 C 中电流的有效值 I_1 = I_2 = 10 A，并且端口电压 u 与总电流 i 同相。
求总电流 I、并联部分电压 U_2 和电感电压 U_L 的有效值，进而确定 R、X_C、X_L。

questions.explain: 以 U_2 为参考：I_1 与 U_2 同相，I_2 超前 90°，两者相等 → I = 10√2 ≈ 14.14 A，超前 U_2 45°。

questions.ask: 并联部分电压有效值 U_2 = ?
questions.explain: U 与 I 同相，即 U 与 U_2 的夹角为 45°；U_L 超前 I 90°，与 U 垂直。直角三角形中 U_2 是斜边：U_2 = U/cos 45° = 100√2 ≈ 141.4 V。
直角三角形 U_2² = U² + U_L² → U_L = √(20000 − 10000) = 100 V（等腰直角三角形）。

questions.ask: 由此得到的元件参数是？

hints: 并联部分以电压 U_2 为参考相量最方便：I_1 与 U_2 同相，I_2 超前 U_2 90°。
I = I_1 + I_2，I_1 = I_2 → I 超前 U_2 45°。U_L 超前 I 90°，而 U 与 I 同相，所以 U ⊥ U_L。
画出 U = U_L + U_2 的三角形：它是以 U_2 为斜边的直角三角形，且有一个 45° 角。
solution: **2. 电感电压。** U_L = jX_L·I 超前 I 90°，相位为 135°。
**3. 同相条件。** U 与 I 同相，相位 45°，所以 U ⊥ U_L。KVL：U_2 = U − U_L，三个相量构成直角三角形，U_2 为斜边，它与 U 的夹角为 45°。

en.title: Phasor diagram: port voltage in phase with the current
statement: R and C in parallel are in series with L; the element values are unknown. The source voltage has rms value U = 100 V, the rms currents in R and C are I_1 = I_2 = 10 A, and the port voltage u is in phase with the total current i.
Find the rms total current I, the rms voltage U_2 across the parallel part and the rms inductor voltage U_L, and from them R, X_C and X_L.

questions.explain: Take U_2 as reference: I_1 is in phase with U_2, I_2 leads by 90°, and they are equal → I = 10√2 ≈ 14.14 A, leading U_2 by 45°.

questions.ask: rms voltage across the parallel part, U_2 = ?
questions.explain: U is in phase with I, so the angle between U and U_2 is 45°; U_L leads I by 90°, so it is perpendicular to U. In this right triangle U_2 is the hypotenuse: U_2 = U/cos 45° = 100√2 ≈ 141.4 V.
Right triangle: U_2² = U² + U_L² → U_L = √(20000 − 10000) = 100 V (an isosceles right triangle).

questions.ask: Which element values follow from this?

hints: For the parallel part take its voltage U_2 as the reference phasor: I_1 is in phase with U_2, I_2 leads U_2 by 90°.
I = I_1 + I_2 with I_1 = I_2, so I leads U_2 by 45°. U_L leads I by 90°, and U is in phase with I, so U ⊥ U_L.
Draw the triangle U = U_L + U_2: a right triangle with U_2 as the hypotenuse and a 45° angle.
solution: **2. Inductor voltage.** U_L = jX_L·I leads I by 90°, i.e. its angle is 135°.
**3. In-phase condition.** U is in phase with I (angle 45°), so U ⊥ U_L. KVL: U_2 = U − U_L; the three phasors form a right triangle with hypotenuse U_2, at 45° to U.
**4. Solve the triangle.** U_2 = U/cos 45° = **141.4 V**, U_L = U·tan 45° = **100 V**.
